name: cya
description: cya — a tamagotchi-style virtual hangout room

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && (cd server && uv sync)
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "cd server && uv run uvicorn main:asgi_app --reload --port 3001" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: cd server && uv run uvicorn main:asgi_app --port 3001
